crossRefs.note: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.
It was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs, who were doorkeepers…
The king said, “What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this?” Then the king’s servants who attended him…

translations.web: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
translations.bsb: Now a poor wise man was found in the city, and he saved the city by his wisdom. Yet no one remembered that poor man.
translations.kjv: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
translations.asv: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
